answers.prompt: At sea level, at what temperature in Celsius does water boil?
answers.text:
Water boils at **100°C** (212°F) at sea level, which corresponds to standard atmospheric pressure of 1 atmosphere (about 101.3 kPa or 14.7 psi).

answers.text:
# Train Distance Calculation

**Given information:**
- Speed = 60 km/h
- Time = 2.5 hours

**Formula:**
$$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$$

**Calculation:**
$$\text{Distance} = 60 \text{ km/h} \times 2.5 \text{ h} = 150 \text{ km}$$

**Answer:** The train travels **150 kilometres**.
